# PropagationSolver { #clerq.PropagationSolver }

```python
PropagationSolver(
    system=None,
    t_min=0.0,
    t_max=1.0,
    t_steps=100,
    method='mesolve',
    opts=None,
    savefile=None,
    z_min=0.0,
    z_max=1.0,
    z_steps=10,
    z_steps_inner=2,
    num_density_z_func=None,
    num_density_z_args=None,
    interaction_strengths=None,
    velocity_classes=None,
    *,
    atom=None,
)
```

Solver for the propagation of fields through a medium of systems.

Steps the fields through space with a finite-difference method, solving
the Lindblad master equation for the :class:`~clerq.system.System` at
each step (once per velocity class if the medium is Doppler broadened).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                  | Type                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Default     |
|-----------------------|-----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| system                | dict \| None          | Dict (or empty dict for defaults) describing the quantum system; passed to :class:`~clerq.system.System`.                                                                                                                                                                                       | `None`      |
| t_min                 | float                 | Start time of the simulation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `0.0`       |
| t_max                 | float                 | End time of the simulation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `1.0`       |
| t_steps               | int                   | Number of time steps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `100`       |
| method                | str                   | Solver method — ``'mesolve'`` (Lindblad master equation) is the only supported value.                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `'mesolve'` |
| opts                  | dict \| None          | Dict of QuTiP solver options.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `None`      |
| savefile              | str \| None           | Path prefix for caching solved results (``'.qu'`` extension appended automatically). Pass ``None`` to disable caching.                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`      |
| z_min                 | float                 | The front of the medium.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `0.0`       |
| z_max                 | float                 | The back of the medium.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `1.0`       |
| z_steps               | int                   | Number of space steps at which the solution is recorded.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `10`        |
| z_steps_inner         | int                   | Number of finite-difference steps made within each space step.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `2`         |
| num_density_z_func    | str \| None           | Name of a function in ``clerq.t_funcs`` giving the number density profile over z. Square by default.                                                                                                                                                                                            | `None`      |
| num_density_z_args    | dict \| None          | Dict of arguments for ``num_density_z_func``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `None`      |
| interaction_strengths | list\[float\] \| None | Interaction strength of each field with the medium, one for each field.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `None`      |
| velocity_classes      | dict \| None          | Dict defining the velocity classes for Doppler broadening, or ``None`` for no broadening. ``thermal_width`` and the ``thermal_delta_*`` values are cyclic frequencies, in the same units as ``decays`` rates and ``rabi_freq``. The weights are Gaussian, ``exp(-(delta / thermal_width)**2)``. | `None`      |
| atom                  | dict \| None          | Deprecated name for ``system``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `None`      |

### build_velocity_classes { #clerq.PropagationSolver.build_velocity_classes }

```python
PropagationSolver.build_velocity_classes(velocity_classes=None)
```

Build the velocity-class detuning grid and Boltzmann weights.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type         | Description                                                                                                 | Default   |
|------------------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| velocity_classes | dict \| None | dict of velocity-class parameters, or None for the no-Doppler-broadening case (single detuning class at 0). | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                            | Description                           |
|--------|---------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
|        | tuple\[np.ndarray, np.ndarray\] | (thermal_delta_list, thermal_weights) |

### build_zlist { #clerq.PropagationSolver.build_zlist }

```python
PropagationSolver.build_zlist(z_min, z_max, z_steps, z_steps_inner)
```

Builds the space grid.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type   | Description                                                                                                | Default    |
|---------------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| z_min         | float  | The front of the medium, in your chosen length unit.                                                       | _required_ |
| z_max         | float  | The back of the medium.                                                                                    | _required_ |
| z_steps       | int    | The number of even-spaced steps on which to solve and record the solution.                                 | _required_ |
| z_steps_inner | int    | Between each z_step, make this many inner steps of the finite-difference solver (for numerical stability). | _required_ |

#### Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- If the problem requires a lot of space steps for stability, but
    you don't need to record the solution at such a high-level of
    resolution, increase z_steps_inner.

### coherences { #clerq.PropagationSolver.coherences }

```python
PropagationSolver.coherences(coupled_levels)
```

Gets the sum of coherences (off-diagonals) in a list of coupled
    level pairs.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                | Description                      | Default    |
|----------------|---------------------|----------------------------------|------------|
| coupled_levels | list\[list\[int\]\] | a list of pairs of level indexes | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                           |
|--------|------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | np.array, shape (z_steps+1, t_steps+1), dtype=complex |

#### Note {.doc-section .doc-section-note}

Unlike ``System.get_fields_sum_coherence``, which operates on a
single-z time series with per-field weighting factors, this method
sums over the full (z, t) array with unit weights.

### init_Omegas_zt { #clerq.PropagationSolver.init_Omegas_zt }

```python
PropagationSolver.init_Omegas_zt()
```

Inits the Rabi frequency array.

_Omegas_zt is the internal angular-frequency field array;
``rabi_freqs_zt`` is its public cyclic view.

_Omegas_zt shape: (num_fields, z_steps+1, t_steps+1) — field-first.
states_zt shape: (z_steps+1, t_steps+1, num_states, num_states) — z-first.
These are inconsistent; correcting either is a breaking API change,
deferred to a future major version.

### init_states_zt { #clerq.PropagationSolver.init_states_zt }

```python
PropagationSolver.init_states_zt()
```

Inits the system density matrices.

### load_results { #clerq.PropagationSolver.load_results }

```python
PropagationSolver.load_results()
```

Loads the solution from a QuTiP pickle file.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                                   |
|--------|------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | if the savefile was built from a different problem definition (hash mismatch), or was solved with the old factor**2 source-term weights and a field has factors other than 1. |

#### Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- The path from which the results will be loaded is taken from
    self.savefile.
- Old savefiles without metadata are loaded without integrity
    checking, with a warning, unless a field has factors other
    than 1 (see Raises).

### solve { #clerq.PropagationSolver.solve }

```python
PropagationSolver.solve(
    step='ab',
    rho0=None,
    recalc=True,
    progress=True,
    progress_show_area=False,
    check_counter_prop_depletion=True,
    depletion_warn=0.01,
    depletion_error=0.1,
)
```

Solves the propagation of the fields through the medium.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                         | Type   | Description                                                                                                         | Default   |
|------------------------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| step                         | str    | 'euler (for Euler method) or 'ab' (for Adams-Bashforth)                                                             | `'ab'`    |
| rho0                         | Qobj   | the initial density matrix state                                                                                    | `None`    |
| recalc                       | bool   | Recalculate the solution even if a savefile exists?                                                                 | `True`    |
| progress                     | bool   | Show a tqdm progress bar with elapsed time, ETA and current max field amplitude.                                    | `True`    |
| progress_show_area           | bool   | Extend the progress bar with the pulse area ∫\|Ω\|dt for each field at the current z-step.  Requires progress=True. | `False`   |
| check_counter_prop_depletion | bool   | Run a post-solve depletion check on any counter-propagating fields. Set False to suppress.                          | `True`    |
| depletion_warn               | float  | Depletion fraction that triggers a UserWarning.                                                                     | `0.01`    |
| depletion_error              | float  | Depletion fraction that raises CounterPropagatingDepletionError.                                                    | `0.1`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                                               |
|--------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | self.rabi_freqs_zt: The solved field complex (cyclic) Rabi frequency at each point in space z and time t. |
|        | np.ndarray | self.states_zt: The solved density matrix at each point in space z and time t.                            |

### to_autodiff { #clerq.PropagationSolver.to_autodiff }

```python
PropagationSolver.to_autodiff(**options)
```

Return a differentiable version of this problem.

The result reproduces :meth:`solve` as a pure function of a parameter
pytree (pulse parameters, interaction strengths, detunings, decay scale,
or sampled input fields), so the propagated field and any loss of it can
be differentiated exactly with JAX autodiff. Requires the ``jax`` extra
(``pip install 'clerq[jax]'``) and ``jax_enable_x64``.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                                                                                                                | Default   |
|-----------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| **options | Any    | forwarded to :class:`clerq.autodiff.AutodiffPropagation` (``step``, ``strategy``, ``rtol``, ``atol``, ``max_steps``, ...). | `{}`      |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                             |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|        | Any    | The differentiable problem, an ``AutodiffPropagation``. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                | Description                                                                              |
|--------|---------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ImportError         | if the ``jax`` extra is not installed.                                                   |
|        | NotImplementedError | for counter-propagating fields or pulse functions the autodiff backend does not support. |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> ad = solver.to_autodiff()
>>> value, grads = ad.value_and_grad(loss)
```
